title: agg_daily_rides volume collapse caused by stale raw.trips_raw feed
description:
Causal chain: `raw.trips_raw` → `stg_trips` → `fct_trips` → `agg_daily_rides`.

Live evidence: `raw.trips_raw` is a source node with no upstreams and is 26.02 hours stale against a 6-hour SLA. `stg_trips` is 25.01 hours stale and fell from 1,281,900 to 3,120 rows. `fct_trips` has 3,120 rows versus its 50,000 minimum. The symptom `agg_daily_rides` has 4 rows versus 182 previously and expected 25..400.

Blast radius contains 15 downstream entities, including Exec Daily Ops (3,100 weekly views), Rides by Hour (1,840), and fct_trips (2,121 queries/30d). Human remediation is required: restore/backfill the trips ingestion at `raw.trips_raw`, rerun downstream pipelines, and validate assertions before marking fixed.

incidentStatus.message: Root cause confirmed and evidence preserved: raw.trips_raw is 26.39h stale against a 6h SLA with no upstreams, causing the agg_daily_rides volume failure. Human remediation is still required to restore/backfill ingestion and rerun/validate downstream pipelines; no warehouse data was changed.
